thread:
ops_lee: Heads up, after the firewall microseg cutover in ap-south-1 we're seeing a spike of GPU artifact-fetch failures and KMS denies during node join. ~30% of warmups failing.

infra_tom: Confirmed. errors in artifact-proxy: '403 access_denied' and keystore logs show 'Decrypt: AccessDenied' for ephemeral node role.

sre_maya: node join traces: kubelet waits for model blobs, fails, then eventually times out and gets evicted. cold-starts >3m for affected tenants.

security_ana: the microseg change added a default deny for host->privatelink egress unless security-tagged. looks like gpu-warmup service-account didn't get the new tag.

ops_lee: immediate mitigation: add a short-lived firewall exception for src-tag=svc:gpu-warmup -> privatelink-keystore and artifacts privatelink CIDs. Can we get 20m approval?

security_ana: approve 20m with TTL and audit entry. we need the rule created via terraform or ORA template so it's traceable.

infra_tom: creating TF change now, will push a short-lived allow with annotation `ephemeral-exception=1736664321`. patch snippet: ```hcl
resource "fw_rule" "gpu_warmup_allow" {
  name = "tmp-gpu-warmup-allow-1736664321"
  src_tag = "svc:gpu-warmup"
  dst_cidrs = ["10.20.11.0/24", "10.20.12.0/24"] 
  ttl_minutes = 20
}
```
Apply in 2m.

deploybot: apply queued to CANARY (ap-southeast-1) then AP-SOUTH-1 after health checks.

ops_lee: parallel workaround: enable local artifact-cache on new nodes to reduce remote fetchs. patch: ```bash
kubectl patch ds gpu-warmup -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"warmup","env":[{"name":"ARTIFACT_CACHE","value":"/var/cache/artifacts"}]}]}}}}'
```
This will make warmup attempt local cache before remote.

sre_maya: pushed canary, warmup success back to ~92% on canary nodes. rolling to region.

infra_tom: root cause action items: 1) update onboarding doc to include security tagging for svc:gpu-warmup, 2) add test in release gating that simulates privatelink egress after firewall changes, 3) change microseg policy to allow service-account binding rather than tag-only.

security_ana: long-term: prefer IAM role-bound exception so we don't rely on tags that drift. will draft a playbook.

billing_sam: cost note - flow logs and increased privatelink throughput during the mitigation plus the ephemeral exception are estimated ~$2.7k/mo if we keep higher sampling. add to next budget review.

product_ravi: alerting/sla hit: notify support and accounts for customers impacted by cold-start regressions. we need a crisp customer note.

ops_lee: monitoring followups: add alert: `gpu_warmup_artifact_fail_rate > 0.1 for 5m`, `kms_decrypt_errors > 5/min`. add tag `firewall_exc_ephemeral=1736664321` to follow events.

security_ana: exception created and annotated in TF state, TTL 20m. I'll open a follow-up ticket to track IAM-role binding for exceptions.

ops_lee: rolling out post-canary to prod regions now. will post final PM/incident note to #incidents when finished. thanks all. :thumbsup:
